description: This file defines an abstract base class for univariate statistical measures within the Apache Commons Math library. It provides methods for setting, getting, and validating data arrays, and declares abstract evaluate methods that subclasses must implement.

classes.name: AbstractUnivariateStatistic
classes.description: Abstract base class for all implementations of the UnivariateStatistic interface, providing default implementations for data handling and validation methods.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the data array by copying the input array; can also clear data if input is null.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns a copy of the stored data array.

methods.name: getDataRef
methods.description: Returns a reference to the stored data array.

methods.name: setData (overloaded)
methods.description: Sets a subset of the data array from a specified begin index and length, after validation.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the statistic over the stored data or a given array.

methods.name: evaluate (abstract)
methods.description: Evaluate the statistic over a subarray specified by begin index and length; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the statistic object.

methods.name: test (protected)
methods.description: Validates that a subarray of the input array is within bounds and of positive length.

methods.name: test (overloaded, protected)
methods.description: Validates subarray parameters including allowEmpty flag.

methods.name: test (additional protected method)
methods.description: Validates subarray with weights, ensuring weights are non-negative, finite, not NaN, and not all zero.

methods.name: test (another overload)
methods.description: Validates subarray and weights array with allowEmpty parameter, ensuring integrity of inputs and weights.
